newspec-a: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue))
Nursing Home (API): pass — get null, no row names the id in any patient-linked table, audit for the patient = before + 1 delete row with the earlier PHI_READ kept, control unchanged. Hospital (API and card trash icon -> OK): chart, list projection and every other table clean, audit trail correct, control unchanged, BUT the Quick Dictation compartment placed on the deleted patient survives: quickDictationDrafts row with assignedPatientId = the deleted id, assignedLabel '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …', and the dictated text; the Quick Dictation screen after the delete still lists '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …' with Dictate / Re-assign. The confirm dialog read: 'Remove <name> from the rounding list? This will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data for this patient.'
Product issue: After a physician deletes a Hospital patient (trash icon -> OK), opening Quick Dictation still shows a compartment labelled with the deleted patient's room and full name ('412 · <name>') holding what was dictated for them; the stored quickDictationDrafts row still points at the deleted chart. Fails TC-01/S20's oracle, which lists quickDictationDrafts among the patient-linked tables that must hold no row naming the id (TFA-92579 AC 2: 'immediately (hard delete, not hidden)'). deleteRoundingPatient (convex/rounding.ts) never touches quickDictationDrafts. Overlaps TC-24 Q6(a) (whether the compartment and its 'room · name' label must go) and is already listed in the TC-24 risks.

testCase.name: [local] S20 Hard delete is immediate and complete in both contexts; the earlier access trail stays; the neighbour is untouched

descriptionHtml:
Decision D5 · P0 · Daniela

After a patient is deleted, a Quick Dictation box with their name, room and dictated text remains — delete it too?; and a deleted patient's unsent text stays in another device's draft store until sign-out (Q10)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-25/S17

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S20 Hard delete is immediate and complete in both contexts; the earlier access trail stays; the neighbour is untouched

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept. (TFA-92579 AC 2; UAT TC-24)
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-01; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Per context, a target and a control patient. Hospital target: pre-round text, a task, a medication row and a Quick Dictation placement. NH target: pre-round text, a task and a medication row (Quick Dictation is Hospital only). access.logChartAccess called on each target, so a PHI_READ row exists

When Delete each target through rounding:remove / snf:remove, and once more through the card's trash icon → OK (when S17's runner exists); read the backend on the first query after the mutation returns (no sweep, no cron)

Then get(id) is null; zero rows reference the id in every patient-linked table; audit_logs by_patient(id) = count before + 1 delete row and the earlier PHI_READ row is still there; the control patient's rows are unchanged

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): AC 2 'immediately (hard delete, not hidden)' + 'audit log … kept'. A deleted flag, a removed list row with the document left behind, a cascaded PHI_READ row, or a changed control row fails. Whether the Quick Dictation compartment text itself must go (not only its assignment) is TC-24 Q6. Hospital UI half overlaps TC-24 S13; …

Where it ran: local newspec-a (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa

After a physician deletes a Hospital patient, the chart and its data are gone, but Quick Dictation still shows a box labelled with that patient's room and full name, holding what was dictated for them.

Evidence: newspec-a (API and card trash -> OK). The Nursing Home half passes; the audit trail is kept and the control patient is unchanged. A quickDictationDrafts row keeps assignedPatientId = the deleted id plus the label '412 · <name>' and the text, because deleteRoundingPatient never touches quickDictationDrafts. This is exactly TC-24 Q6(a), which asks whether the box must go, and it is listed in the TC-24 risks. The leftover link to the deleted id fails the S20 oracle whatever Q6 decides; if Daniela agrees, Tim fixes it.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-a.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local (dev partial: get(id) null and missing from the list through user functions, as in S17); Source: newspec-a.

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S20

Hard delete is immediate and complete in both contexts; the earlier access trail stays; the neighbour is untouched

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-a: status failed in newspec-a/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-a/plan.json, automatable: yes): New api spec, per context a target and a control: Hospital target with preRoundNotes, a task, a medication row and a Quick Dictation compartment assigned to it; NH target with preRoundNotes, task, medication. logChartAccess on each target. Delete via rounding:remove / snf:remove; on the first read after: get(id) null, admin system reads of every patient-linked table (roundingPatients/snfResidents, *List projections, quickDictationDrafts, unassignedRoundingItems, handoffs) find no row naming the id, audit rows for the patient = before + 1 delete row with the PHI_READ still there, control rows byte-identical. UI half (trash icon -> OK) on the Hospital card too. — All reads are admin system reads on the local stack; deletion is the app's own mutation / card control.

Detail:

Nursing Home (API): pass — get null, no row names the id in any patient-linked table, audit for the patient = before + 1 delete row with the earlier PHI_READ kept, control unchanged. Hospital (API and card trash icon -> OK): chart, list projection and every other table clean, audit trail correct, control unchanged, BUT the Quick Dictation compartment placed on the deleted patient survives: quickDictationDrafts row with assignedPatientId = the deleted id, assignedLabel '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …', and the dictated text; the Quick Dictation screen after the delete still lists '412 · QA Hosp Del Target …' with Dictate / Re-assign. The confirm dialog read: 'Remove <name> from the rounding list? This will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data for this patient.'

Product issue: After a physician deletes a Hospital patient (trash icon -> OK), opening Quick Dictation still shows a compartment labelled with the deleted patient's room and full name ('412 · <name>') holding what was dictated for them; the stored quickDictationDrafts row still points at the deleted chart. Fails TC-01/S20's oracle, which lists quickDictationDrafts among the patient-linked tables that must hold no row naming the id (TFA-92579 AC 2: 'immediately (hard delete, not hidden)'). deleteRoundingPatient (convex/rounding.ts) never touches quickDictationDrafts. Overlaps TC-24 Q6(a) (whether the compartment and its 'room · name' label must go) and is already listed in the TC-24 risks.

Evidence: 8 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our api spec, not written yet): it seeds, logs chart access and adminQueries every patient-linked table and audit_logs with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
